about: The city opened float applications for this parade with a November 14 deadline, so the lineup is set by city staff well before the night. Parade units are announced by MCs at the judges' stand at Harbor Drive and Atlantic Boulevard.
Atlantic Boulevard east of the bridge is a road closure for the evening, so plan to walk in from the parking at 2400 East Atlantic Blvd instead of looking for a curb spot.

Atlantic Boulevard is the main east west street through the city's beach side downtown, and the parade is the city's kickoff to the season. The city asks families to bring friends and arrive early for a good seat along the route.
faq: Where does the Yuletide on Atlantic parade start and end?
The city says it starts at Riverside Drive, heads west on Atlantic Boulevard and ends at SE 24th Avenue.
When do the roads close for Yuletide on Atlantic?
East Atlantic Boulevard closes at 4:30 PM and the bridge is locked in the down position from 6 to 9:30 PM, according to the city's event page.
Is Yuletide on Atlantic free?
Yes. The city's event page lists the parade as free.
Where do I park for Yuletide on Atlantic?
The city lists parking at 2400 East Atlantic Blvd.

about: The city's recreation page lists this as an all ages event, but it counts everyone ages 3 and up as a ticket holder at $7 each, so budget by head count rather than by child.
Parks and Recreation took ticket sales through its online catalog starting November 2. The city's holiday news post also features Donuts with Santa as the pick for little ones this season.
The Emma Lou Olson Civic Center is at 1801 NE 6th St. The morning pairs pastries with a game show format activity, so kids are seated and participating rather than waiting in a long line.
faq: Who needs a ticket for Donuts with Santa in Pompano Beach?
The city says tickets are required for everyone ages 3 and up at $7 each.
What phone number do I call about Donuts with Santa?
The city lists 954-786-4111 for more information.
How much is Donuts with Santa in Pompano Beach?
The city lists tickets at $7 each, required for everyone ages 3 and up.
What time is Donuts with Santa?
It runs from 9 AM to 11 AM on Saturday, December 12, 2026.

about: This year's parade is presented by the Greater Pompano Beach Chamber of Commerce, which is putting its own boat in the water for the first time. The Chamber Boat Experience is limited, and the city page prices it at $200 per person with an open bar.
Harbor's Edge Park at 1240 NE 28th Ave is one named viewing spot, and the parade is livestreamed on Facebook and YouTube if the weather or the bedtime does not cooperate.

The Chamber bills this as South Florida's favorite holiday tradition on the water, and boaters compete for the best themed boat. Boat registration for the parade was open on the Chamber's site before the event.
faq: What is the theme of the 2026 Pompano Beach boat parade?
The Chamber's theme is A Party in the U.S.A., and it expects more than 50 boats.
Can I watch the boat parade from home?
Yes. The city page says the parade is livestreamed on Facebook and YouTube.
Where is the VIP viewing party for the boat parade?
The Chamber's official VIP Viewing Party is at The Cove in Deerfield Beach, with tickets at $100 per person.
How long does the Pompano Beach boat parade run?
The city lists it from 6 PM to 9:30 PM on Friday, December 11, along the Intracoastal Waterway.

about: Old Town Untapped is a monthly first Friday block party, and the December edition adds the city Christmas tree lighting at 7 PM. The Jeff Lloyd Band plays, and Bailey Contemporary Arts Center opens new gallery shows that night.
Docent led gallery tours run from 8 to 8:45 PM for older kids and adults who want a quieter hour. Guests can register for the free event for a chance at a monthly giveaway.

Bailey Contemporary Arts Center is at 41 NE 1st Street, and its page says the block party sits near NE 1st Street and N Flagler Avenue in the heart of Downtown Pompano Beach. Chairs and blankets are welcome on the lawn.
faq: What time is the Pompano Beach tree lighting at Old Town Untapped?
The city's press release says the Christmas Tree Lighting Ceremony is at 7 PM on Friday, December 4.
Are there food options at Old Town Untapped?
Yes. The city lists a selection of food trucks along with live music and local artists.
How often is Old Town Untapped held?
Bailey Contemporary Arts says it happens every first Friday of the month, and December is the holiday edition.
